text: We are NOT married, and this is in Afula and after getting permanent residency: We had to write a personal letter, they told us that on the day that we went to submit the request at the general counter with a 'normal/general' (i.e. not visa) appointment. They let us write the letter on the spot, we wrote something simple reviewing that we had been together for x time, went through the gradual process over x years, and now want to apply for citizenship to continue my life here as a full member of society. We submitted it together with the citizenship application form and the declaration signed by a lawyer and paid. After we submitted, a few days later they sent an email with the list of all the documents we had to bring to the appointment, these did not include anything from home country, only (many) documents to prove center of life for the past 3 years.
